sample_voice_prompts.sample: వరంగల్ హనుమకొండ నక్కలగుట్ట రోడ్డులో పెద్ద డ్రైనేజీ పైపు పగిలిపోయి 15 రోజులుగా తాగునీరు కలుషితం అవుతోంది. రోడ్డు మొత్తం కూలిపోయే ప్రమాదం ఉంది. త్వరగా రిపేర్ చేయించండి.
sample_voice_prompts.english_translation: In Warangal Hanumakonda Nakkalagutta road, a major drainage pipe has burst, contaminating drinking water for 15 days. The entire road is at risk of cave-in. Please repair urgently.

sample_voice_prompts.sample: बहराइच के ब्लॉक नानपारा में प्राथमिक विद्यालय और अस्पताल जाने वाला मुख्य पुलिया बाढ़ से टूट गया है। बच्चे स्कूल नहीं जा पा रहे हैं।
sample_voice_prompts.english_translation: In Bahraich, Nanpara block, the main culvert leading to the primary school and hospital has collapsed due to floods. Children cannot reach school.

sample_voice_prompts.sample: पुणे चाकण एमआयडीसी रोडवर महामार्गावर मोठे खड्डे पडले असून दररोज ट्रॅफिक जाम आणि अपघात होत आहेत. पथदिवे बंद आहेत.
sample_voice_prompts.english_translation: On the Pune Chakan MIDC road highway, massive craters have formed causing daily gridlock and fatal accidents. Streetlights are also non-functional.

sample_voice_prompts.sample: கோயம்புத்தூர் பீளமேடு பகுதியில் மழைநீர் வடிகால் அடைத்து சாக்கடை நீர் வீடுகளுக்குள் நுழைகிறது. உடனடியாக சரிசெய்யவும்.
sample_voice_prompts.english_translation: In Coimbatore Peelamedu area, stormwater drains are blocked and sewage water is entering residential homes. Immediate clearance required.
